resources.string:
Updated the names of Music, Device Messaging and Color Vision Simulator, refreshed app icons, and aligned their rounded corners and margins.

Music imports show the current file, progress and a cancel action. Improved mixed-folder filtering and large-library performance.

Select songs or all search matches and edit metadata in Music search; selections remain checked in My songs.

Fixed the store scrolling to the top after installation and clarified references to other apps.
